history.prompt: Telephoto compression, 200mm long-lens view of endless rows of generic step-van delivery trucks parked in a massive industrial fleet yard. Stacked overlapping layers of structure receding into atmospheric haze, flat compressed perspective. Overcast light, cool desaturated palette with muted tones. No people in the foreground, no recognizable logos or branding on the trucks.

An extreme close-up macro photograph of a heavy metal diesel fuel pump nozzle. 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane. Shallow depth of field, visible surface texture, scratches, and dust on the metal surface. Soft directional daylight. The hero object is positioned off-centre on the thirds, with a blurred, muted background falling away.

style_when: the article explains how a system, process or stack actually works — money flows, supply chains, pipelines, an agent assembly line
prompt: clean isometric cutaway illustration of a fragmented modular delivery routing grid with intersecting conveyor belts, scattered distribution hubs, and industrial fuel tanks, technical drawing style, axonometric projection, flat muted palette with a bright amber accent colour highlighting the broken pathways, thin consistent line weight, recognisable hardware, generous empty margin
